detail: Gold entities (tests/fixtures/gold) imported as Codex entities, all-lower-case gold forms as titles; recall = sum over entities of min(mentions found, gold occurrences) / gold occurrences. Mentions match names, aliases and titles as whole words, longest match first across all entities, case-insensitive unless exact_case (titles always ignore case); a title counts only in a scene where the same entity is also named. The misses are titles in scenes that do not name the entity (Pablo's 'el ciego': 101 of 117) and unlisted uses of the Virgin (35 of 40).
